profile.summary: skfd demonstrates **mid-level expertise** in JavaScript through focused contributions to the Moment.js library, specializing in locale systems, minification, and build process improvements. Their work shows deep understanding of how Moment.js handles locale dependencies and execution order in minified environments, along with contributions to documentation and release engineering. While evidence is limited to Moment.js-specific patterns, their problem-solving approach and technical communication suggest strong debugging and collaboration skills. No direct evidence of modern frameworks or backend Node.js experience, but strong legacy JavaScript and library maintenance proficiency.
